swap_rule.name: spread_floor_mid_v1

synthetic_input_rule.name: splitmix64_pseudoword_text_v1
synthetic_input_rule.text: space-joined pseudo-words (2-4 syllables from a fixed 70-syllable table), '. ' after every 12th word, newline after every 80th word; all choices from a splitmix64 stream seeded by seed_for(L, rep)
synthetic_input_rule.length: text is tokenized (add_special_tokens=False) in 2048-word chunks and concatenated; the first L ids are sent as input_ids, so prompt_tokens == L exactly (no retokenization)
synthetic_input_rule.seed: request j uses splitmix64((20261021 ^ (2048 << 8) ^ j)); j = 0..7 plain, j = 8 logprob request
